$comment: Canada Line maintenance, nights of Sep 27–30 2026 (TransLink alert, verified 2026-09-26; PLAN.md §4.10). Guesses, to confirm: the start time (the alert says 9 or 11 PM; 21:00 is used every night) and the branch headway (the alert gives reduced headways, e.g. 'Waterfront Station - Bridgeport Station - 10 minutes'; the Richmond branch figure is assumed to be 10 minutes too). Riders see all trains board at Lansdowne Platform 1 (PLAN.md §4.10), so that's the track kept open.

disruptions.text: Canada Line single-tracking between Bridgeport and Richmond-Brighouse
